each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Submit the solution for task-a9d372c9
import json
import os

# The complete solution
base = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]

solution = []
for i in range(28):
    row = []
    
    # Headers (rows 0-2): all 1s
    if i < 3:
        row = [1] * 28
        if i == 2:
            row[3:] = [4] * 26  # Row 2 has 4s in data region
    else:
        # Data rows: border + period-5 pattern
        row = [1, 1, 4]  # Borders
        phase = (i + 3) % 5
        p = base[phase:] + base[:phase]  # Rotated base pattern
        row.extend(p)  # Append the 25 pattern values
    
    solution.append(row)

# Create the submission JSON
result = {"action": "submit", "grid": solution}

# Save to workspace
workspace = '/home/USER/runs/paper/qwen-in-glm-h-u1/frozen/held-out-6/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace'

print(f"Has zeros: {any(0 in row for row in solution)}")

print("\nSample rows:")
for i in [0, 2, 5, 15, 27]:

    match = pattern == expected
    status = "✓" if match else "✗"
    print(f"Row {i}: phase={expected_phase}, pattern={pattern[:5]}... [{status}]")
